Body.Content:
Approvers need access to the financial information behind an expense to make accurate approval decisions without leaving the approval experience. Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app will surface relevant financial dimensions directly within expense report approvals in the mobile app. Approvers can review financial coding in context before making a decision, helping reduce unnecessary navigation and keep expense approvals moving.

GA date: December CY2026
